# Mem++

> Mem++ is AIDAChip's open-source organizational memory engine for LLM agents. It stores verbatim, dated source records and retrieves evidence using PostgreSQL full-text search, pgvector embeddings, and tags attached to source records.

Python 3.13+ and PostgreSQL with pgvector are required. The default embedding model runs locally on CPU using ONNX MiniLM-384. The verbatim write and retrieval paths need no generative LLM calls. Optional extraction, consolidation, and answer/judge configurations have separate model requirements.

Sharing across contributors within an organization/project is intended. Independent benchmark examples must use distinct explicit scopes. Source-record tags are supported; the separate entity-graph research variant is not packaged in this release.

The Textual Add/Search evaluation adapter is implemented. Its presence does not establish public hosting, Agent Memory Leaderboard (AML) registration, organizer acceptance, or a leaderboard score. The local LoCoMo project-scope audit validates retrieval isolation, not answer accuracy or reproduction of the paper results.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus/main/README.md): Installation, Python usage, configuration, Textual evaluation API, evaluation instructions, and reported results with context.
- [Package metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus/main/pyproject.toml): Python requirements, dependencies, and optional extras.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus/main/SECURITY.md): Security reporting guidance.
- [License](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0 license.

## Implementation and evidence

- [Python recall and write interface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus/main/memory/recall.py): Verbatim writes, recall helpers, and project scope handling.
- [Textual Add/Search service](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus/main/memory/aml_api.py): Bearer authentication, atomic ingestion retries, scoped retrieval, and stable evidence IDs.
- [Retrieval isolation audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus/main/docs/evaluations/2026-10-15-locomo-project-scope.json): Local LoCoMo retrieval validation and its limitations.

## Optional

- [Research paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02002): Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents.
